cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the WordPress Content Manager position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I believe I am well-equipped to contribute to your team's success.

In my current role at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation. I write SEO-optimized blog posts and manage WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme, ensuring seamless content updates and page builds. My ability to track performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics allows me to make data-driven decisions that improve organic visibility and search rankings.

One of my proudest achievements is my personal project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my strategic thinking and technical execution, from planning to performance optimization.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it aligns with my passion for creating and managing high-quality content that drives results. My experience in team collaboration, stakeholder management, and performance tracking has prepared me to lead content initiatives and contribute to your company's growth.

I am eager to bring my unique combination of technical expertise, strategic vision, and results-driven mindset to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
